input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale: Section 13 provides automatic successive one-year (not multi-year) renewals with a mutual 30-day non-renewal notice, which satisfies the preferred renewal term and notice window. However, two preferred elements are missing: there is no Vendor reminder ahead of renewal, and renewal pricing is uncapped — Section 6 only freezes Hosting Services costs for the first year, so TrueLink could raise fees without limit at each renewal. Redline adds a 60-day TrueLink renewal/fee-change reminder and caps renewal increases at the lesser of CPI and 3% (fallback 5%).

proposal.summary: Add vendor renewal reminder and cap renewal-term price increases at lesser of CPI and 3%.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The one-year auto-renewal and 30-day non-renewal notice work for us, but we need a reminder before each renewal and predictable renewal pricing, so we have added a 60-day TrueLink reminder and capped any renewal increase at the lesser of CPI and 3%. If a hard cap is difficult, we could accept a 5% ceiling as a fallback.

ops.oldText: unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
ops.newText: unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year. TrueLink shall notify Client in writing of the upcoming renewal, and of any proposed change in fees for the renewal period, no later than sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term.

ops.oldText: TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement
ops.newText: TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement, and that fees for any renewal period will not increase by more than the lesser of (i) the increase in the Consumer Price Index over the preceding twelve (12) months and (ii) three percent (3%) of the fees in effect for the immediately preceding term
